randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: Hey, kiddo... Come closer.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: I know things look rough right now. But you... you've got something most people don't.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: You're going to save this world. I believe that with everything I have left.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: There you are...

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: I wish I could stand up and walk beside you. But my legs gave out a long time ago.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: That doesn't matter though. You're stronger than I ever was. Go prove it.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: Back again? Good. I like seeing your face.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: Every great hero started out not knowing what they were doing. You're right on schedule.

randomLines.speaker: player
randomLines.text: You really think I can do this?

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: I don't think it. I know it.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: The world's in bad shape, kid. Worse than when I was your age.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: But it chose you for a reason. And so did I, when I brought you here.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: Don't carry the weight alone. Find friends. Trust them. Then save us all.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: You know what kept me going all those years out there?

randomLines.speaker: player
randomLines.text: What?

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: Knowing I'd come home to you. And now you're the one heading out.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: Make it count. I'll be right here when you get back.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: Hmm? Oh, don't mind me. Just resting my eyes.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: Listen... whatever happens out there, remember who you are.

randomLines.speaker: npc
randomLines.text: You're my kid. And my kid doesn't give up.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I'm proud of you. Always have been.
